units.source_text: 但是，她突然落入伍死一般的假寐里，丰满的乳房在枕边灯的照耀下呈现出光泽来。

en.t: But suddenly, she slipped into a deathlike doze, and her full breasts gleamed in the light of the bedside lamp.

units.source_text: 苍蝇也忽然像落入了梦乡，纹丝不动。

en.t: The fly, too, suddenly seemed to have fallen into a dream and did not move at all.
